leadText:
(Japanese: キミエ Kimie) is a character of the day who appeared in Extreme Pokémon!.

Kimie lives in the town of Eggseter with her husband Mr. Shellby. She was holding an when Mr. Shellby took and to their house at the Shellby Ranch. She was next seen speaking to about Pokémon Breeding while Ash was practicing for the Extreme Pokémon Race.

She hosted the race alongside Mr. Shellby. During the race, Kimie witnessed 's balloon fall onto the ranch with freed from their net. After Ash defeated Team Rocket and won the race, Mr. Shellby rewarded Ash with a Egg, and Kimie and her husband waved Ash and his friends goodbye.
